usage: ai-effort-ledger report timesheet [--store FOLDER] [--json] [--language {en,it}] [-h]
                                         --from DAY --to DAY [--freeze] [--note TEXT]
                                         [--idle-gap DURATION] [--minimum-attention DURATION]
                                         [--stale-limit DURATION] [--headless-prompts {yes,no}]
                                         [--timesheet-granularity DURATION]

the daily timesheet of a period

options:
  --store FOLDER                    use another store folder for this command only
  --json                            write the result as one JSON document
  --language {en,it}                the language of the output
  -h, --help                        show this help message and exit
  --from DAY                        the first day of the period
  --to DAY                          the last day
  --freeze                          keep the report also as a frozen report
  --note TEXT                       a note for the event or for the report
  --idle-gap DURATION               the idle gap of the figures, such as 10min
  --minimum-attention DURATION      the minimum attention time of the figures
  --stale-limit DURATION            the stale limit of the figures
  --headless-prompts {yes,no}       whether the figures count headless prompts as human signals
  --timesheet-granularity DURATION  the granularity of the proposal of the timesheet
